title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

title: Our Christmas Wedding
description: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

title: Hot Chocolate Holiday
description: A coffee shop owner finds herself in competition with the handsome owner of a dessert shop whose hot chocolate tastes just like her grandmother's secret recipe.

title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
description: When a girl quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, her family discovers that some of God's greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness.

title: Joy for Christmas
description: A publicist introduces a famous athlete to the joys of Christmas in the hopes that he will assist her in saving her family's annual charity.

title: A Christmas Blessing
description: A TV chef is divinely inspired to take over her late aunt's charity with help from a new friend and handsome neighbor.

title: Another Sweet Christmas
description: When Sophie and Sam's picture-perfect love story is transformed into a Christmas movie, their hometown of Waynesbridge, Washington, becomes a dazzling holiday film set. But as the spotlight grows brighter, real-life challenges soon follow.

title: Last Vermont Christmas
description: Megan and her two sisters reunite every Christmas in their childhood home. This year, though, their parents have put the house up for sale, and the buyer is Megan's former childhood sweetheart, Nash.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

title: The Christmas Yes List
description: A chronic people-pleaser returns home for Christmas, determined to finally say yes to herself. An unexpected romance helps her discover that life's greatest gifts often come when you stop fearing the answer.

title: Peppermint and Postcards
description: When 9-year-old Megan dedicates her Christmas wish to helping her mom Cara find love, her letter goes viral. Cara realizes that what she was looking for may have been on her doorstop all along.

title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

title: Crown Prince of Christmas
description: Madison jokingly tells her overbearing family that she is dating the prince of a small European nation. The joke goes too far as her friend/co-worker Sebastian is roped into impersonating the prince while visiting her family in New Jersey.

title: My Favorite Christmas Tree
description: Kyla visits a small town attempting to find her ancestry and meets a Christmas tree farm owner.

title: Let It Snow
description: An executive examines her company's new property and prepares a presentation to transform the rustic lodge into a new hot spot. She tries to ignore the lodge's festive celebrations during her stay, but an unexpected romance changes her heart.

title: A Merry Christmas Wish
description: An NYC advertising executive returns to her hometown to sell the family farm but instead reconnects with her childhood friend and gets involved with organizing the yearly Winter Wonderland, which takes place on the property.

title: Home Sweet Christmas
description: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.

title: Journey to Christmas
description: A winter storm forces a New York City fashion model to spend the week before Christmas with her chauffeur and his extended family in rural America.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
description: Stranded in an arctic town during Christmastime, a single father and his 20-year-old daughter meet a wildlife conservationist who helps them navigate the frozen wilderness.

title: Catering Christmas
description: Fledgling caterer Molly Frost is hired by perfectionist Jean Harrison for the renowned Harrison Foundation's annual Christmas Gala, but things get complicated when she falls for Jean's nephew, a photographer with no desire to take over the foundation. Molly shows Carson all the good his family is able to provide.
